_doc: Codex texture sheets for the Spell Kit. Each sheet is one 1536x1024 picture: grid 'cells' (3 columns x 2 rows of 512x512) or 'bands' (4 rows of 1536x256). Everything is painted in WHITE and greys on PURE BLACK so the kit can tint it per school and use brightness as see-through. tools/codex-sheets.mjs paints them, tools/cut-sheets.py cuts them into textures/.
style: hand-painted stylised fantasy MMO spell-effect texture, like the painted VFX textures of a classic 2004 fantasy MMO: soft painterly brush strokes, glowing cores fading to soft edges, readable shapes, no photo realism
